name: teamsherrard-agent-attraction
description: Team Sherrard's Agent Attraction OS: plug-and-play AI systems for real estate agents who attract agents to a cloud-brokerage organization, a local team, or a local brokerage.

plugins.name: attraction-ai-brain
plugins.description: PLUGIN 1 — install first. The Agent Attraction Brain: one shared brain (who you are as a leader, who you attract, what you have to give, your numbers, your voice, your brand, your rules) that every other Agent Attraction system reads. Run 'Set up my attraction brain' once; every tool already knows you. Includes the Daily Agent Attraction Debrief, Prospect Radar, the Brokerage Model Expert, the Rev Share Calculator, and the on-the-go Capture layer.

plugins.name: maa-claude-support
plugins.description: PLUGIN 2 — install with Plugin 1. MAA Claude Support: the help desk for the Master Agent Attraction cohort. Say "help" for any Claude question, a look-only diagnosis, a setup audit, what week you're in and the catch-up plan, and "what did Mike say about…" answered from the full MAA lesson knowledge base with the lesson to rewatch. Read-only by constitution; routes every fix to the skill that owns it.

plugins.name: attraction-shortform-system
plugins.description: PLUGIN 3 — the Short-Form Attraction Engine (Week 3): the daily Instagram engine for attracting agents. Pillars, bios, Reel scripts, carousels, stories, hooks, the 30-day calendar and weekly routine, the comment-to-DM ladder with the ManyChat keyword, publishing, and analytics. Requires Plugin 1.

plugins.name: attraction-youtube-system
plugins.description: PLUGIN 5 — the Long-Form Authority Engine (Week 4): YouTube built to attract agents. Channel, 3-pillar game plan on the 8-video cycle, ideation, research, scripts, agent interviews, model breakdowns, thumbnail briefs, SEO, repurposing, leads, analytics, coaching, consistency, board. Requires Plugin 1.

plugins.name: realtor-riverside-editor
plugins.description: PLUGIN 4 — the AI Editing Studio on Riverside (Week 3). The SAME editor plugin as the Social Agent OS, vendored here unchanged except for one rule: it reads whichever Brain you have (Agent Attraction Brain first, Realtor AI Brain otherwise). Record, edit by transcript, cut the fluff, captions, b-roll, music, color, hook, interviews, reels, long-form, repurpose, publish. If you already installed it from the realtor marketplace, do not install it twice.

plugins.name: attraction-conversion-sales
plugins.description: PLUGIN 6 — the Conversation & Conversion Engine (Week 5): Agent Intel, Conversation Starter, DM-to-call flow, call prep, the partner call and enrollment script, 3-way calls, the Objection Handling Coach (15 objections, role-play), the Conversation Coach (call audits), follow-up and re-engagement, plus Sales OPS (booking page, show-up, setter, call block, scorecard). Requires Plugin 1.

plugins.name: attraction-lead-magnet
plugins.description: PLUGIN 8 — Lead Magnets & Opt-In Funnels pointed at agents (Week 6): the Honest Brokerage Comparison Guide first, then magnet ideas, writing, design brief, funnel, delivery, nurture, partnerships, GBP, profiles, analytics. Requires Plugin 1 and a Week 2 offer.

plugins.name: attraction-ai-admin
plugins.description: PLUGIN 7 — the AI Admin for agent attraction (Week 5): morning brief, the prospect pipeline on the locked stages with your CRM, the Daily Follow-Up Queue (drafted, never sent without you), the weekly scorecard and Weekly Recruiting CEO Review, the Team Wins newsletter, VA task packs, the Monthly KPI Review. Requires Plugin 1.

plugins.name: attraction-events-workshops
plugins.description: PLUGIN 9 — Events & Workshops that attract agents (Week 6): live, virtual, and evergreen formats as a launch system — strategy, run-of-show, registration copy, promo calendar (drafted, never sent), follow-up sequences into the pipeline, analytics. Requires Plugin 1 and a Week 2 offer.
